article.title: 43-year-old Swiss man arrested after shooting at rave
article.summary:
(ANSA) - ROME, AUG 31 - A 43-year-old Swiss man was arrested this morning by cantonal police as part of the investigation into the shooting at a rave in Aarau over the weekend in which an Italian woman was killed, the Corriere del Ticino reports.
According to the police, the man is the sole perpetrator of the crime.
The victim, 22-year-old Maria Spinelli, was killed in an apparently motiveless attack in which two other Italians were among five people slightly injured.
Spinelli, a Roma woman, had studied at a hotel hospitality school in Italy and had decided to try to make her way in the sector in Switzerland.
She was a waitress.
Premier Giorgia Meloni voiced condolences and called for full light to be shone on the incident. (ANSA).Read article...
